name: Mr. Vijay (Nazir, MACT Rohini, Court No. 12)
organisation: Rohini Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (District Courts, Delhi)
context: 26 Feb 2026, 12:50 PM: Kesar Kanjhlia and Deepak held a telephonic consultation (referred by Adv. Oct 2025: Justice Midha advised documenting FastDAR non-implementation as an advocacy case 'for MoRTH and the Supreme Court' (the SC had mandated all states adopt the FastDAR framework). 20 Apr 2026: Yuvraj shared the SC ruling barring heavy vehicles from parking/stopping on national highways. Jun 2026: Siddharthnagar representations cited 'the directions of the Supreme Court Committee on Road Safety'. 4-5 Aug 2026: National Insurance Co. v. Thungala Dhana Laxmi (Sanjay Karol & Prashant Kumar Mishra JJ) - see the dedicated bench record for the SATARK-relevant detail; Deepanshu flagged it internally on 5 Aug (verified in full) as 'the Supreme Court has essentially described our product [SATARK]', with compliance responses due 14 Aug and next hearing 18 Aug 2026; CFI's plan is to pull compliance affidavits after the hearing to find states with admitted gaps ('warmest leads') and write to all Transport Commissioners. The most active current matter as of Sep 2026 is In Re: Phalodi Accident (Suo Motu) SMW(C) 9/2025, registered 10 Nov 2025 after twin highway crashes killed 34 (near Phalodi, Rajasthan and Chevella, Telangana); its 13 Apr 2026 order directed, within 60 days: a ban on heavy-vehicle highway-carriageway parking, demolition of unauthorised right-of-way structures, District Highway Safety Task Forces, land-use restrictions near National Highways, ambulance/crane deployment at <=75km intervals, and an Advanced Traffic Management System rollout; on 3 Sep 2026 the Court recorded non-compliance by MoRTH, MHA and Tamil Nadu with these Article 142 interim directions, gave two weeks for compliance affidavits on pain of the Secretaries/Chief Secretary appearing personally, and directed NHAI to supply information to the amicus. Other tracked matters: SaveLIFE Foundation's Good Samaritan (disposed 2016, now S.134A MV Act) and Emergency Care (W.P.(C) 726/2024, pending - see the Maheshwari J record for the 26 May 2026 PM RAHAT order, next listed ~Sep 2026); Gohar Mohammed (Detailed Accident Report workflow, monitoring continues 2026); Shishupal @ Shish Ram v. Surjeet (11 Jun 2026, homemaker compensation valuation, circulated to all High Court Registrars General); and Re: Fundamental Right to Walk (24 Aug 2026, all States/UTs and MoRTH impleaded on footpath directions).
